decisions.reason: Connects the top-level import to the classic-script combo compile failure, explains atomic parse killing all 53 registrations, identifies typert-registry as the first awaited innocent victim, and does not overgeneralize ESM as invalid everywhere.

Bisects the insert rows and fully describes the ModuleLoader.load bundle, package-name identity, host React via require, and inject/apply exports; but relies on node --check as a classic-script parse without noting it alone can accept ESM (no vm.Script-equivalent caveat).

Explains declaration ownership and cross-entry ordering, but the shown inject form passes the component directly with a placeholder key and explicitly defers the exact signature; it also wrongly claims the registrant must not pass the slot name, contradicting the registrant-owned name/id/order contract.

Explains the once-per-boot combo assembly, why edits and refresh do not rebuild, full restart per iteration with Windows tree kill and port verification, and EADDRINUSE as the orphaned old process retaining the port.

Proposes compose-time per-bundle classic-script validation and culprit-first attribution at combo failure, plus an authoring template/checklist covering factory, host React, inject/apply, deferred slot injection, and restart/tree-kill discipline.

caps.reason: Final advice requires the loader wrapper over bare ESM, slots.inject over immediate registration, drops kind/scope, and mandates full host restarts; no contradiction present.
